shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat — plus paintable glass skylight zones (stackable, grow-light sun), mountain-top rivers with waterfalls, island-aware logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection OR compile-ref. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message on trip. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- See-below VISION extends through skylight glass; **a pane is a WINDOW: installing it flood-unfogs the connected room below (2026-07-24 live-test fix)**. Orders through glass = orders through air.
- All levels are real maps (pocket maps, tick every game tick). Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir (Impassable) + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop (Standable) + AB_Skylight (Standable glass, dontRender).

## LIVE TEST ROUND 1 FINDINGS (2026-07-24, isolated session) — fixes built, RELAUNCH PENDING
User-reported: (1) "right click still does not work across levels"; (2) "skylight zones on ground level do not create a window to the basement" (screenshot: installed glass grid with opaque black areas). No bridge errors fired — both were logic/UX, not exceptions.
1. **Skylight black window = basement FOG drawn opaque (by design) + night (shafts correctly off).** A sealed unexplored basement room is 100% fogged; the mask hides fogged cells. FIX: `SkylightSystem.RevealBelow` — installing a pane flood-unfogs the connected walkable room below it (mining-into-room reveal semantics; solid rock reveals just the cell); ValidateShafts applies it to pre-fix saves on load. Night behavior stands (windows do not light at night; lamp or daytime shows the room).
2. **RMB gap = no stairs right-click option.** Testers right-click the STAIRS first, never discovering view-switch flow. FIX: GetOptions POSTFIX (same patch class, Redirecting-guarded, revalidation-dedup by label) appends "go up/down via X" (Keyed AB_GoUpVia/AB_GoDownVia, MenuOptionPriority.High, stairs icon) for a single selected colonist clicking a same-map stairwell with a usable counterpart; forbidden ends offer nothing (door parity; uses stairs.EndForbiddenFor — NOT the door-only IsForbiddenToPass extension). Cross-level menu flow itself unchanged (needs view of target level; drafted pawns get goto-drag + no work options = vanilla parity).
3. **Dev tool `AB: RMB diagnostic` (ToolMap)**: runs ShouldRedirect + BuildOptions for the current selection at the clicked cell, logs ONE Log.Warning decision trace (crosses the bridge): selection maps/drafted states, guard+setting, resolved target level, redirect verdict, option count + first 10 labels. Ground truth for any further RMB report.

## RMB 1:1 PARITY BATCH (2026-07-24) — built; ReplayFresh regeneration replay, column-wide selection, hop-chain routing, glass clicks, transformed nested clickPos. (Details unchanged from 9th pass; stairs option + diagnostic added in live round 1.)
## DIRECT-TO-BLUEPRINT HAULING — built (site resolved at scan; FinishOnSite continuation; fail-open to drop-at-stairs).
## BELOW-LEVEL LIGHTING — built (lower map's LightingOverlay into the band at offset 75, type-included, altitude-exempt; setting `belowLighting` default ON). NOTE for testers: a roofed unlit basement at night is CORRECTLY black — vanilla parity.
## ANIMAL FLOW FIX — built (pet return trips scribed; wild hard-overdue escape; linger overflow).
## BETTER ARCHITECT MENU COMPAT — built (detection-gated transpiles onto ColumnThingsOfDef).
## PERF PASS + PERF-MOD COMPLIANCE — complete (PO/TPT decompile-audited; invariants in code).
## BATCH D (skylights + rivers/waterfalls) — built; skylight fog-reveal added. BATCH A user-verified; B/C built pending; food/logistics/areas/combat unchanged.
## SETTINGS — seven tabs (+skylights, mountainRivers, skyVisitorArrivals, hospitalityRoaming, belowLighting).

## Test plan (current)
- **RELAUNCH round 2 (isolated, PRIORITY)**: (a) skylight over sealed basement room -> install -> room revealed + visible through glass (daytime; night = dark unless lamped); (b) right-click stairs -> "go up/down via" option undrafted AND drafted; (c) UNDRAFTED pawn cross-level construction: view sky, surface pawn selected, right-click sky blueprint -> enabled prioritize row -> walks up, delivers FRESH; (d) if any RMB case fails: select pawns, palette "AB: RMB diagnostic", click the cell — trace arrives via bridge; (e) below lighting: lamp below at night visible from above; (f) direct-to-blueprint: construction-only pawn carries straight to site.
- Then: animal flow, BAM (companion), Batch B+D, Batch C, perf-mod smoke, older stack.

## Compat
(unchanged) + Better Architect Menu. Perf mods audited. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-24 (10th pass): live round 1 triaged — **skylight fog-reveal, stairs right-click option, RMB diagnostic tool built compile-green**. Awaiting relaunch for round 2 verification.
